LanguageData.MooGirl_Bar.label: Mugirl Bra "Pouvoir Impérial de la Nuit"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Bar.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a black Gothic lace full-cup bra, with ornate silver-thread embroidery gracing the cups.\nIt lifts the silhouette like a coronation, a secret declaration of luxury flowing beneath outer garments.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Bikini.label: Mugirl Bikini "Carillon des Neiges"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Bikini.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a cow-print bikini, where a black leather neck collar with a silver bell cannot constrain the graceful bust.\nThe dappled black and white pattern sways with the hips, the clear chime a manifesto poised between innocence and desire.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Bikini_Stocking.label: Mugirl Bikini (With Stockings) "Flamme Marbrée"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Bikini_Stocking.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a cow-print strappy bikini paired with over-knee socks, where the neck bell resonates with the wearer's movements.\nThe clash of black and white ignites a visual wildness, each step stirring the primal instinct to hunt.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Eroticpanties.label: Mugirl Erotic Underpants "Mystère du Jardin de Miel"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Eroticpanties.description: "Vache Rousse" presents black Gothic lace panties, with intricate silver embroidery creating a labyrinth at the hip line.\nA glorious breaching of the final defence, luring adventurers one step closer into forbidden territory.
